patch_description: Add a second, contact-graph-aware polishing stage after each successful exact SLSQP solve. The first solve identifies the emergent minimum-distance and diameter contacts. A short regularized solve then reduces slack variation on those contacts while retaining every original feasibility constraint, followed by a final pure max-t solve. This can improve convergence in the degenerate active-set regime where many equivalent diameter/minimum constraints make a single linear-objective SLSQP pass terminate slightly short of the best feasible packing.
